demonstrated_edges: The complete-feed path fires the type-1 producer EXACTLY ONCE per GetPicture on all four sweep points (60/120/180/240 B), serving and stalling alike. No multi-round demand cadence exists on any observed path.

The only post-dispatch re-entry into getMpegPicture is the onComplete continuation at MPEG.cpp:2484 (C2a's site); it runs on both branches. C4's site (:2496-2513) is reached only on branches that stall.
The three loops in the path are bounded by registration-list exhaustion, offered-buffer exhaustion, and decodedFrames non-emptiness. None is a demand-round bound; no round counter exists.

completeExternalWait IS raised on the served branch and matches ZERO waiters (mpeg-complete matched=0): the wake edge is inert even when the bytes suffice. The onComplete retry is the only mechanism that has ever delivered a picture.

In the title boot, 29 guest writes reached the producer/source windows, all before the park; 0 in the 66 s after it, while a guest thread remained scheduled ~300x per 5 s and DMA/GIF counters stayed frozen.
why: The trigger point transfers (C2a's site already runs on the title) but the bound does not: the complete path stops because decodedFrames stops being empty, a gate the title never closes. The only non-invented extra bound, 'the producer supplied no new bytes', was measured and would fire on the second round with no frame produced - the boot shows the guest source is not refilled while the caller is parked. Implementing C2a or C4 would therefore add a demand policy that provably cannot produce a picture.
gate_decision: STOP with X named and moved upstream
x_before: The edge from 'parser holds accepted bytes but emitted no packet' back to the registered type-1 producer, plus its termination rule (E22).
x_after: The missing bytes are not obtainable at the demand edge at all. X moves upstream of MPEG: why does the guest hand over exactly 5,040 B and then leave every thread waiting (thread 1 on Mpeg, threads 2-6 on semaphores 26/30/32/36) with DMA and GIF frozen? The next dependency is the producer's own source, not the host's demand policy.
residual_named: The descriptor head advanced to 0x548880 at boot-log line 10168 and that successor node was not in the watched set; its silence is vacuous. Follow-up: watch 0x548880-0x5488ff and the 0xd48748+ data region.
